source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
During the Declare Battle Formations step, **LEGIONARIES** and **CULTIST MOB** units of yours may be picked, up to a cap per type set by battle size:

- Incursion: 2 of each.
- Strike Force: 3 of each.
- Onslaught: 4 of each.

Until the battle ends, the picked units, plus each attached **CHARACTER** unit (not **EPIC HEROES**), have [Infiltrators](vsdata:core-ability/infiltrators).

grants.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 1 of 8 sampled ability grants of Detachment rules wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
